description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ProvisioningCriteriaCannotBeCreatedException' in the org.apache.fineract.organisation.provisioning.exception package. It extends the AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException class and is used to signal issues related to creating provisioning criteria within the provisioning module of Fineract.

classes.name: ProvisioningCriteriaCannotBeCreatedException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating failure to create provisioning criteria, extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException.

methods.name: ProvisioningCriteriaCannotBeCreatedException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a globalisation message code, a default user message, and optional message arguments.
